text: This report provides the Audit Results, as prepared by KPMG, to assist the Board in reviewing the financial statement for the year ended December 31, 2023. The Audit Results Report was reviewed and discussed at the Policy and Finance Committee meeting on May 27, 2024.
The Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo: 1. Received the report (May 27, 2024) from the Director, Finance, Technology, and Innovation for information.
